design: One full-color leaf histogram builder shares packed floor averages and a channel pass across fourteen modes, replacing the generic leaf loop. Decoder prediction, green-only analysis, recursive history, entropy, candidate order/ties and ownership are unchanged. No new allocation, pool, session or budget.
